_about: Failures tools/check-all.py already knows about. A FAIL or ERROR line that matches one of these is reported as known, not new, and does not fail the run. check: the check name (a regex, e.g. check-waters or check-glance|check-bait). target: preview, live or local (leave out for all). match: a regex tried against the failure line without its FAIL/ERROR word. Remove an entry as soon as its cause is fixed, so a return shows up as new.
